article.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
article.summary: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

all_candidates.title: Amazon’s Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at $75
all_candidates.summary: Amazon-owned Bee has launched its first new AI devices since its acquisition, including an updated wearable and a credit-card-sized recorder that attaches to smartphones. The devices can summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping, with prices starting at $74.99.

all_candidates.title: 国内WebサイトへのAIエージェント攻撃を観測　「8時間弱」続いた攻撃の推移を公開　国内セキュリティベンダー
all_candidates.summary: ビットフォレストが、日本企業のWebサイトへのAIエージェントによる攻撃を観測したと報告。10月14日までに3つのIPアドレスから確認し、うち1つは8時間弱にわたり10段階に攻撃を変化させたという。
